title.zh: 矿企Hut 8再次抛售约2148枚比特币，Q3及季后合计卖币筹资约2.5亿美元
title.en: 矿企Hut 8再次抛售约2148枚比特币，Q3及季后合计卖币筹资约2.5亿美元

current_state.zh: Bitcoin miner Hut 8 disclosed selling roughly 2,148 BTC after Q3 — about 3,100 BTC and $250M in proceeds combined with Q3 sales — to complete a $250M share buyback, and raised its repurchase authorization to $1B.
